name: scaled-interview-data-assistant
description: Reconstruct real customer switching decisions from interviews with source-located evidence, reviewed A-to-B relationships, rival behavioral explanations, and provisional product-decision handoffs. Separate reported behavior from hypotheses and simulations.

interface.shortDescription: Turn switching interviews into auditable product research
interface.longDescription: Reconstruct customer decisions, build source-located evidence, compare rival behavioral explanations, and hand provisional research findings to shaping. Keep human review, simulations, and observed outcomes distinct.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this customer switching interview and cite every material finding.
Audit this JTBD synthesis against its original transcript.
Explore rival behavioral explanations without choosing a product yet.
